summary: Pickup truck went off US Highway 550 between mile markers 88 and 89 and plummeted 300 ft into the Uncompahgre River Gorge; first responders performed a technical rope rescue of the sole occupant, who had minor injuries.
responding_agency: Ouray Mountain Rescue Team; Ouray County EMS; Ouray Volunteer Fire Department; Ouray County Sheriff's Office; Colorado Department of Transportation; Colorado State Highway Patrol
